UTF-8 Test Data
================

Basic ASCII: Hello World!

Latin Extended: Café, naïve, résumé
Greek: Ελληνικά (Greek)
Cyrillic: Русский язык (Russian)
Arabic: العربية (Arabic) - right-to-left text
Chinese: 中文 (Chinese)
Japanese: 日本語 (Japanese)
Korean: 한국어 (Korean)

Emoji: 🌍🌎🌏 🚀 💻 🎉 ✨ 🔥 💎 🌟

Mathematical symbols: ∑∞≠≤≥∈∅∩∪
Currency: €£¥₹₽¢

Special characters:
- Zero-width space: ​
- Non-breaking space:  
- Various quotes: ""''‚„«»‹›
- Dashes: –—
- Bullet points: •‣⁃

Multi-byte sequences:
- Three-byte: ☃ (snowman)
- Four-byte: 𝕳𝖊𝖑𝖑𝖔 (mathematical script)
- Combining characters: é (e + acute accent)

Line endings test:
Unix LF: ↵
Windows CRLF: ↵
Mac CR: ↵

Control characters mixed with text:
	Tab character before this line
Form feed: 

Null bytes and special cases should be handled carefully.

This file tests various UTF-8 encoding scenarios for comprehensive testing.
